description: Build embeddable "Share on WhatsApp" widget HTML (web and email variants) with a link preview card and a pre-filled message. Returns self-contained HTML.

buttonPlacement.description: Where to place the share button relative to the card (optional).

buttonText.description: Call-to-action button text (optional; defaults to "Share on WhatsApp").

description.description: Message text shown above the card (supports *bold*, _italic_, ~strike~).

domain.description: Domain label shown on the card (optional).

includeCredit.description: Append a small "Widget by WhaTools" credit line under the widget (optional; default false).

title.description: Title shown on the preview card.

name: build_whatsapp_share_widget
